summary: Building GenAI-powered analytics platforms and real-time data pipelines with Kafka and Snowflake Cortex AI — plus mentoring engineers and running the team as scrum master.
Led a screening platform that consolidated multiple data vendors, drove a 1TB+ PostgreSQL migration, and pushed the team toward a DevOps-first delivery model.
Built Spring Boot microservices and UK Open Banking–compliant payment workflows for a fintech client, along with reusable UI components.
